results.previousDetail: 'פער של אגורות אינו מזוהה כפער' is an over-generalisation. The code truncates each absolute value separately, not the difference: a sub-shekel gap that crosses a whole-shekel boundary IS flagged (e.g. 100.99 vs 101.00 -> 100 != 101 -> state 15), while gaps up to 0.99 inside the same whole shekel are not. Also Abs makes opposite-sign equal amounts compare equal. Correct: comparison of Truncate(Abs(x)) per value; written amount keeps original sign.

results.detail: Re-check: text now explicitly says UNVERIFIABLE, separates unproven general T-SQL knowledge (whitespace allowed inside compound comparison operators -> '<> 5', status 6 included, NULL excluded) from circumstantial DTSX evidence (externalMetadataColumns isUsed=True, 7 columns, DTSX:2236-2244), and states the consequence if it does not parse (no DelayValidation -> package validation fails, neither close flow runs). Accurate; the parse question itself remains unsettled from the DTSX alone - legitimately UNVERIFIABLE.
results.previousDetail: Cannot be settled by execution from the DTSX alone. (1) T-SQL knowledge (not proven here): SQL Server's parser accepts whitespace between the characters of compound comparison operators ('! =', '< >', '> ='), so '! =5' would parse as '<> 5'. (2) Circumstantial DTSX evidence: the OLE DB Source carries externalMetadataColumns isUsed=True with exactly the 7 columns of this select list, i.e. the designer described this command successfully at some point. (3) Consequence if it did NOT parse: no DelayValidation is set and ValidateExternalMetadata defaults to True, so package validation would fail before any task runs - the automatic flow would not run either, not only the manual one; if it failed later at PreExecute, 'Close manualy sended withdrawals' fails, End ETL (Success constraint DTSX:5315) is skipped and the OnError handler marks gen_etlprocess failed. If it parses, semantics = feedbackstatus <> 5 (status 6 included, NULL excluded) vs NOT IN (5,6) in the auto flow. Production execution logs are needed to close this.
